0.2.0.description:
- Replaced 'Nothing' filler items witch **heal and armor items**.
- Added a new **Air Strike trap**.
- Added **Death Link** support for the game.
- Some **UI fixes.** Only show requiremnt tracking if there is an acutal requirement for it. Locked all collections that are not included in the current seed.

0.3.0.description:
### **What is new**
- **Weapon & Equipment randomization**
  - You can now lock the weapons and equipment behind item checks.
  - Unavailable items have a red outline and you the player is unable to interact with them.
  - Unavailable items don't show up on the minimap, to avoid any confusion.
  - AP world logic for weapon randomization.
- **Pickup locations**
  - These include Bushes, Health Kits and Armor items on the ground.
  - You only need to interact with these, don't need to acutally pick them up if you on max health.
  - Pickups that still need to be interacted have a yellow highlight around them.
  - Two logic options:
    - **Individual** => Each pickup on the level is a different locations.
    - **Grouped** => Pickups are grouped by level. You need to pick up all of them on a level on a single try.
    
###  **What changed**
 - **Deathlink**
   - Death link now also trigger when you time out on a level.
   - Also triggers when you out of bounds for too long.
 - Made the **Super Strength** filler a rarer drop compared to the other items.  
 
 ### **Future updates**
- Different logic paths for Weapon randomization. Current version is more of a casual playthrough. It does not force you to do harder locations with minimal unlocked. This is coming in a later update, together with Glitched logic that uses some out of bounds skips.
- More and improved Archipelago UI elements
  - Improved AP connection window.
  - Show received and sent items in game.
  - List of all the locations that are currently in logic.

0.3.1.description:
**Bug Fixes**
  - Apworld now works on Linux as well.
  - Corrected rules for Story Level 1.
  - Fixed incorrect pickup counts on Cold Sweat 1, 6 and 7.
  - _Maybe fixed Bonus Objective locations not sending properly?_
  - Fixed Story Level 27 not counting toward completion and not sending properly.
  
 **Changes**
  - Added Death Link amnesty. Amount can be changed in the yaml settings.
  - You can now disconnect and reconnect to Archipelago from the Main Menu.
  
  **NOTE: The newest mod version in R2Modman is 0.3.2!**

0.3.3.description:
**Bug Fixes**
  - Fixed weapons being locked even when weapon rando is off.
  - Fixed a generating but when Kick unlock is enable without weapons.

0.3.4.description:
# I Am Your Beast Archipelago 0.3.4

## Improvements

### APWorld
- Changed the `.yaml` description to add missing information and make each option easier to understand.
- Added a new option to exclude Horde levels from the pool.
- Added a new option to change Map Type to show armor items on the map.

### Mod
- Level names are always visible on the level select screen.
- Cutscenes are hidden by default on the level select screen. Can be toggled on or off.
- Added a button to only show levels that are available on the level select screen. Can be toggled on or off.
- Optionally added armor items to the map. Can be changed in the YAML settings.
- When connecting to Archipelago from the Menu, all items are resynced with the server and all checks that are done in your save file but were never sent are sent. The game might freeze for a while when connecting if there are a lot of these.

## Fixes

### Mod
- Weapons are now visible on the minimap when weapon randomization is not enabled.
- *Maybe* fixed Bonus Objective locations not sending properly. Again.

## Note

**This version is not compatible with already hosted multiworlds.**
